scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shared,server,client -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @commied/shared" "npm run dev -w @commied/server" "npm run dev -w @commied/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @commied/shared && npm run build -w @commied/server && npm run build -w @commied/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @commied/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
